name: rus-image-percent-gen
description: DeepSeek Harness bundle: Russian UI localization, element scaling (80-220%), pixel-art drawing (pixel_art), and outbound proxy choice with its own settings page - HTTP(S)/SOCKS5, latency and exit-country checks (proxy_switch).
author: Daymix

meta.title: Русский язык, масштаб, рисунки и прокси
meta.titleEn: Russian UI, scaling, pixel art and proxy
meta.description: Один плагин: русский интерфейс, масштаб элементов 80–220 %, инструмент pixel_art (холст до 256×256, предпросмотр ×5/×3, экспорт PNG) и proxy_switch (выбор прокси по пингу со страной выхода).
meta.descriptionEn: One plugin: Russian UI, element scaling 80–220%, the pixel_art tool (canvas up to 256×256, ×5/×3 previews, PNG export) and proxy_switch (latency-based proxy choice with the exit country).
